criteria.label: Every number is sourced
criteria.means: A figure names its system of record and cut date, e.g. "per the FY26 ledger as of 30 Jun".

criteria.label: Every number has a baseline
criteria.means: Plan, last quarter or last year sits next to the figure.

criteria.label: The bumper asks for something
criteria.means: The closing line of each slide says what the room should decide.

criteria.label: Three points, tops
criteria.means: Our board reads three points; the fourth goes in the appendix.

criteria.label: Say it plainly
criteria.means: Words our board has asked us to stop using.

criteria.label: No internal codenames
criteria.means: The board does not know our project names. Say what the project does.

criteria.label: No customer names without sign-off
criteria.means: Name a customer only once Legal has cleared it; otherwise say "a top-10 retailer".
